description: Fast, low-noise spell checking for English and Japanese, powered by a bundled Rust language server.
capabilities.untrusted: Diagnostics work, but commands that modify project configuration or dictionaries require workspace trust.
capabilities.virtual: The bundled language server requires a local or remote filesystem workspace.
configuration.serverPath: Path to an `ayame-spell` executable. Leave empty to use the bundled server, then fall back to `$PATH`.
configuration.mode: Override the checking mode for this workspace.
configuration.mode.corrections: Flag only known misspellings and mechanical Japanese issues.
configuration.mode.dictionary: Also flag words missing from configured dictionaries.
configuration.mode.off: Disable checking while keeping the extension available.
configuration.japanese: Enable Japanese notation and character-width checks.
configuration.fixOnSave: Apply every safe ayame-spell fix before saving.
configuration.trace: Trace communication with the ayame-spell language server.
command.fixAll: ayame-spell: Fix All Safe Issues in File
command.reviewWords: ayame-spell: Review Flagged Words (Bulk Add / Ignore)
command.addSelectionProject: ayame-spell: Add Selection to Project Words
command.addSelectionGlobal: ayame-spell: Add Selection to Global Words
command.openConfig: ayame-spell: Open or Create Project Configuration
walkthrough.title: Get started with ayame-spell
walkthrough.description: Catch high-confidence English typos and Japanese notation inconsistencies without noisy identifier warnings.
walkthrough.corrections.title: Open a file and fix a typo
walkthrough.corrections.description: Known misspellings are underlined automatically. Use Quick Fix or run [Fix All Safe Issues](command:ayame-spell.fixAll).
walkthrough.corrections.alt: An English typo with an ayame-spell quick fix
walkthrough.configure.title: Share project settings
walkthrough.configure.description: Run [Open or Create Project Configuration](command:ayame-spell.openConfig) to configure checking mode, wordlists, and Japanese style in version control.
walkthrough.configure.alt: Japanese notation variants detected in an editor
walkthrough.review.title: Review words in bulk
walkthrough.review.description: Run [Review Flagged Words](command:ayame-spell.reviewWords) to add many terms to project or personal dictionaries in one pass.
walkthrough.review.alt: Bulk review picker for flagged words
